trial_court: Family Court, Purnea in Maintenance Case No. 208 of 2013
case_name: Dev Raj Dev vs The State Of Bihar Through The Principal ... on 20 July, 2018

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Dev Raj Dev, Son of Ramchandra Bhagat, Resident of Shiksha nagar Banmankhi, P.S.- Banmankhi, District- Purnia (Bihar) presently posted at Coimbatore as Commissionar of disciplinary Proceedings.
parties.respondent_defendant: 1. The State of Bihar Through The Principal Secretary General Administration Dept. Govt. of Bihar, Patna .; 2. Pritam Chaudhary, D/o Dr. P.K. Choudhary , Resident of Navratan Hata Purnia, P.S.- K. Hat Purnia, presently Residing at not disclosed and Refused to inform the Court.

facts_of_case: Petitioner seeks a writ of Certiorari to quash and cancel part of order dated 10.11.2016 passed by learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Purnea; also seeks a writ of Mandamus directing the Principal Judge, Family Court, Purnea to get conducted DNA test of applicant, his wife and youngest son in two laboratories at cost of applicant.

legal_principles.principle: DNA testing is the most legitimate and scientifically perfect means to establish assertions of infidelity.
legal_principles.held: We agree with him. In our view, but for the DNA test, it would be impossible for the respondent husband to establish and confirm the assertions made in the pleadings.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to establish paternity through DNA test.
legal_principles.held: We agree with him. In our view, but for the DNA test, it would be impossible for the respondent husband to establish and confirm the assertions made in the pleadings.

outcome.final_order: The further prayer of the petitioner is to issue a writ of Mandamus directing the Principal Judge, Family Court, Purnea to get conducted DNA test of applicant, his wife and youngest son in two laboratories at cost of applicant.
